per_line.text: 它先定目标，再决定下一步。
用工具拿回结果，再改计划。

decision: No atempo correction. The speech-only average is 250.9 cpm, inside 220-260. Per-line outliers (186.5-334.6) come from 7-11 unit lines where a fixed tail and punctuation dominate; slowing those would make the delivery unnatural. The over-video number (135) counts the 4 s windows' silence and is not a speaking-rate measure.
